summary: The public v0 CLI installs from a nested vzero Go module so the installable module path never ends in /v0.
reason: Go semantic import versioning reserves trailing /vN suffixes and rejects explicit /v0 or /v1 suffixes, so npm and direct Go install paths must target library/ai/v0/vzero while preserving the public v0 catalog slug, binary, skill, config paths, and release tags.
validated_outcome: go list ./cmd/v0-pp-cli resolves the package under module github.com/mvanhorn/printing-press-library/library/ai/v0/vzero.
